notes: Drafted by 30 agents, merged, every slug verified live against leetcode.com, then hand-pruned (linked-list cycle problems, string-backtracking partitions, plain tree recursion, greedy look-alikes removed). | v1 adds 86 sub-patterns across 18 non-DP/graph families (backtracking, binary_search, bit, design, greedy, hashing, heap, linked_list, math, matrix, prefix_sum, range_query, sliding_window, sorting, stack, tree, trie_string, two_pointers). Those were drafted one family per agent from the shipped catalogue, then every membership was re-read by an independent adversary instructed to drop anything whose solution does not actually use the stated mechanism. Unlike the original 30, they were NOT verified live against leetcode.com: slugs, titles, difficulties and tags come from the bundled catalogue snapshot, so "verified" here means catalogue-consistent and adversary-reviewed.
